title: UK Schools & Colleges Directory (GIAS + Ofsted) — filters

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Current records (default), or only the records added, removed or changed since a date — schedule a daily run in changes mode to monitor the register and pay only for what changed.

since.title: Changes since
since.description: Changes mode only: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the last 7 days. The feed keeps 90 days.

change.title: Change type
change.description: Changes mode only: one kind of change. Default: all three.

phase.title: Phase of education contains
phase.description: e.g. Primary, Secondary, Nursery, 16 plus, All-through

establishment_type.title: Establishment type contains
establishment_type.description: e.g. Academy converter, Community school, Free schools, Further education, Other independent school

status.title: Status contains
status.description: Open, Closed, Proposed to open, Open, but proposed to close. Leave blank for all.

local_authority.title: Local authority contains
local_authority.description: Filter: Local authority contains (case-insensitive substring match).

region.title: Region contains
region.description: London, North West, South East, West Midlands, …

outward_code.title: Postcode area (outward code)
outward_code.description: Filter: Postcode area (outward code) (case-insensitive substring match).

trust_name.title: Academy trust name contains
trust_name.description: Filter: Academy trust name contains (case-insensitive substring match).

pupils_min.title: Minimum pupils on roll
pupils_min.description: Only schools with at least this many pupils at the last census.

pupils_max.title: Maximum pupils on roll
pupils_max.description: Only schools with at most this many pupils at the last census.

max_results.title: Maximum results
max_results.description: Stop after this many records (you are charged per result).
